extra.message: User-controlled application reference reaches EntityManager.createNativeQuery via string concatenation ("select * from application_record where reference = '"+reference+"'"). Called from ApiController.byRef with the {reference} path variable. This is a SQL injection that allows reading/altering arbitrary rows.

cwe: CWE-89: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')

extra.message: The /api/applications/{id}/projection endpoint reads a BeanShell expression from the attacker-controlled calc_rule cookie (@CookieValue defaultValue="annualIncome * 0.9") and passes it to ScriptEngine.eval(). BeanShell evaluates arbitrary Java, so this is remote code execution.

cwe: CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
CWE-95: Improper Neutralization of Directives in Dynamically Evaluated Code

extra.message: The /api/applications/{id}/packet endpoint concatenates the request parameter 'label' directly into a shell command: new ProcessBuilder("sh","-c","soffice --headless --convert-to pdf "+label+" --outdir "+packetDir). Attacker-controlled label allows arbitrary OS command execution.

cwe: CWE-78: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')

extra.message: The /api/applications/{id}/requirement-notice/{section} endpoint builds a FreeMarker template by string-concatenating the user-controlled 'section' path variable into the template source before tpl.process(). An attacker can inject FreeMarker directives/expressions (e.g. ${...}), leading to server-side template injection and potential code execution.

cwe: CWE-1336: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine
CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')

extra.message: The /api/applications/{id}/reference-match endpoint reads criteria/@ref from the uploaded XML and concatenates it into an XPath expression: String expr="//application[reference='"+requestedReference+"']". A value such as '] | //application[reference=' bypasses the intended filter, returning records the caller should not match.

cwe: CWE-643: Improper Neutralization of Data within XPath Expressions ('XPath Injection')

extra.message: The /api/reports/applications/archive endpoint takes the report name from the X-Report-Name header and resolves it against the packet directory without sanitization: Path dest=dir.resolve(reportName); Files.write(dest,...). A value like ../../<path> writes arbitrary files outside the intended directory.

cwe: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

extra.message: The /api/reports/packet-file endpoint resolves the user-supplied 'ref' request parameter directly: Path target=Path.of(packetDir).resolve(ref); Files.newInputStream(target). A value such as ../../etc/passwd reads arbitrary files from the server.

cwe: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

extra.message: The /api/console/applications endpoint trusts the unsigned console_scope cookie to choose the branch scope and role used for data selection (scope=parts[0]; role=parts[1]) and then calls apps.findByBranchCodeOrderByCreatedAtDesc(scope). Any staff user can forge console_scope (e.g. another branch|bank_admin) and read other branches' applications, bypassing the branch authorization enforced by AuthorizationService.

cwe: CWE-639: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key
CWE-284: Improper Access Control

extra.message: Report endpoints (export/archive/shared) accept an X-Br-Scope/Br-Scope value and pass it straight to apps.findByBranchCodeOrderByCreatedAtDesc(brScope) instead of workflow.visible(...), which is what enforces an officer's branch scope. A branch-restricted onboarding officer can supply another branch code and export that branch's application data (IDOR / horizontal privilege escalation).

cwe: CWE-639: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key
CWE-284: Improper Access Control

extra.message: The permitAll /legacy/state/restore endpoint Base64-decodes the legacy_state cookie and feeds it to new ObjectInputStream(...).readObject(). Deserializing untrusted data allows gadget-chain remote code execution. The commons-collections4 dependency on the classpath makes a gadget chain readily available.

cwe: CWE-502: Deserialization of Untrusted Data

extra.message: The permitAll /legacy/applications/resume endpoint parses the caller-supplied 'assertion' with SignedJWT.parse and trusts its subject claim without verifying the signature or any claims (auth.require only looks up the email). An attacker can present a self-crafted JWT with a victim's email to retrieve that user's application reference/status/branch, bypassing authentication.

cwe: CWE-347: Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature
CWE-287: Improper Authentication

extra.message: The /api/reference/directory/{account} endpoint concatenates the user-controlled account path variable into an LDAP search filter: ctx.search(DIRECTORY_BASE_DN,"(&(objectClass=person)(uid="+account+"))",controls). Filter metacharacters (e.g. *)(|(uid=*) ) allow LDAP injection and disclosure of arbitrary directory entries.

cwe: CWE-90: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an LDAP Query ('LDAP Injection')

extra.message: The /api/reference/requirements/import endpoint deserializes the user-supplied 'rules' parameter using ObjectMapper.activateDefaultTyping(LaissezFaireSubTypeValidator.instance, NON_FINAL, As.PROPERTY). Enabling polymorphic default typing with the permissive LaissezFaire validator allows arbitrary class instantiation and known gadget-chain remote code execution.

cwe: CWE-502: Deserialization of Untrusted Data

extra.message: The /api/rek-kyc/campaigns endpoint uses the user-supplied CampaignCreate.callbackUrl to open an outbound connection: (HttpURLConnection)URI.create(b.callbackUrl).toURL().openConnection(), then POSTs to it. This is a server-side request forgery that can reach internal services (e.g. cloud metadata, internal hosts).

cwe: CWE-918: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)

extra.message: PATCH /api/profile binds the client-supplied branchCode into the authenticated user's record (u.branchCode=b.branchCode) with no role or value validation. Because an onboarding_officer's data access is scoped by their own branchCode, an officer can set branchCode to any branch and then read/act on that branch's applications.

cwe: CWE-639: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key
CWE-915: Improperly Controlled Modification of Dynamically-Determined Object Attributes

extra.message: The roster import generates temporary account passwords with java.util.Random: String code=String.valueOf(100000+(int)(Math.random()*900000)). Math.random is not cryptographically secure, so the generated sign-in codes are predictable and brute-forceable.

cwe: CWE-338: Use of Cryptographically Weak Pseudo-Random Number Generator (PRNG)
CWE-330: Use of Insufficiently Random Values

extra.message: GET /api/admin/integrations returns raw secrets to the caller: providerCred (SP/API key), datasourcePwd (database password) and sgnKey (JWT signing secret) based on the X-Cfg-Scope header. Exposing live credentials over an API enables credential theft and further compromise.

cwe: CWE-200: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor

extra.message: legacySignIn hashes the supplied passphrase with unsalted MD5 (DigestUtils.md5Hex) and compares it to the stored legacyDigest. MD5 is a fast, broken hash unsuitable for password verification; the /legacy/sign-in endpoint is unauthenticated, so captured digests can be brute-forced/forged to mint JWTs.

cwe: CWE-916: Use of Password Hash With Insufficient Computational Effort
CWE-327: Use of a Broken or Risky Cryptographic Algorithm

extra.message: ReportSeal encrypts report scopes with AES/CBC/PKCS5Padding using a static, key-derived IV (new IvParameterSpec(key)). Reusing a fixed IV under a fixed key makes the cipher deterministic and enables chosen-plaintext/ciphertext analysis; the sealed report tokens are therefore forgeable.

cwe: CWE-329: Generation of Predictable IV with CBC Mode
CWE-1204: Generation of Weak Initialization Vector (IV)

extra.message: CaseEnvelope seals re-KYC case references with AES/CBC/PKCS5Padding and a static key-derived IV (new IvParameterSpec(key)), producing deterministic ciphertext. Together with the weak default app.case-key, tokens can be precomputed/forged to redeem arbitrary case references.

cwe: CWE-329: Generation of Predictable IV with CBC Mode
CWE-1204: Generation of Weak Initialization Vector (IV)

extra.message: The resource-server filter chain permits all of /legacy/** and /actuator/** without authentication. This exposes the deserialization endpoint (/legacy/state/restore), the unverified-JWT resume endpoint, and all actuator endpoints (env, heapdump, beans) to anonymous callers.

cwe: CWE-306: Missing Authentication for Critical Function

extra.message: Actuator is exposed over the public port and configured to include env, heapdump and beans. With SecurityConfig permitting /actuator/**, anonymous users can read environment properties (including secrets) and download a heap dump that leaks credentials and tokens.

cwe: CWE-200: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor
CWE-16: Configuration

extra.message: The root handler builds a redirect from the user-supplied 'go' query parameter: return "redirect:"+(go==null||go.isBlank()?"/dashboard":go). This allows an open redirect to any external URL (e.g. /?go=https://evil.example), usable for phishing.

cwe: CWE-601: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site ('Open Redirect')

extra.message: The /applications/{id}/print handler returns HTML built by string concatenation of application fields (reference, address, employmentStatus) without any output encoding. address is attacker-controlled via the address_details step, producing stored/reflected cross-site scripting on this text/html endpoint.

cwe: CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

extra.message: The applications handler writes the raw request parameter into a log line: LOG.info("Application queue filtered by status "+status). Embedded CR/LF allow log forging (log injection), which can corrupt or spoof audit/operational logs.

cwe: CWE-117: Improper Output Neutralization for Logs

extra.message: The document download endpoint is annotated @CrossOrigin(originPatterns="*",allowCredentials="true"), reflecting any origin while allowing credentials. A malicious site can therefore read authenticated users' document downloads across domains.

cwe: CWE-942: Permissive Cross-domain Policy with Untrusted Domains

extra.message: The web security filter chain disables the X-Frame-Options/frame-ancestors protection via headers(x->x.frameOptions(fo->fo.disable())), removing clickjacking defenses for all pages.

cwe: CWE-1021: Improper Restriction of Rendered UI Layers or Frames

extra.message: ApplicationService logs applicants' date of birth and national identifier in clear text: LOG.info("intake personal_details ref={} dob={} nid={}",...) with logging.level.root=DEBUG. This writes sensitive personal data (PII) into application logs.

cwe: CWE-532: Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File
